title: Quarterly strategy cascade: hosted API + model fleet commitment and cohort alignment
creator: Sana Patel
description: Organize Q2 commitments for the Hosted API product and model catalog so that model lineup, capacity hedges, and evaluation gates are synchronized across PM, Eng, and Design. Deliver a clear cohort-alignment plan that maps customer cohorts to endpoint tiers, defines canary windows for each model cohort, and produces a single commitment ledger for capacity and rollback policy. This ticket is the cross-functional orchestration artifact that consolidates initiative-level milestones, acceptance gates, and stakeholder responsibilities for the quarter.
success_metrics:
- Canary success rate >= 99% over 72h for each model cohort
- Median P95 latency within target for 95% of endpoints (target defined per tier)
- Cost per 1k tokens within 10% of forecasted budget for hosted endpoints
- Zero customer-facing regressions caught by quality monitors (automated evals) during rollout
- Rollout completion for prioritized cohort list (top 3 customer cohorts) by 2025-06-20
milestones:
1) Strategy finalization and alignment (by 2025-03-10): PRD sign-off, cohort mapping, capacity hedges defined
2) Implementation kickoff (by 2025-03-24): ENG routing + autoscaling tasks scheduled, DES mocks for console changes created
3) Canary windows staged (starting 2025-04-14): run cohort canaries for small traffic slices, validate metrics
4) Expanded rollout (by 2025-05-19): expand to medium cohorts, begin model swap rehearsals
5) Fleet-wide stabilization & retrospective (by 2025-06-20): complete rollout for top cohorts, record lessons and run regression sweep
acceptance_criteria:
- PRD and rollout runbook published and linked in 'links' field
- Canary experiments defined with traffic slices, evaluation prompts, and rollback thresholds
- Console updates for cohort visibility deployed to staging and demoed to PM + CS
- Autoscaling policies and burst capacity allocations for committed endpoints configured and validated in staging
- Cross-team beta invite list created and notified; at least 3 customers complete Canary trials
rollout_plan: Phase A: Internal canaries (dev traffic) -> Phase B: Beta cohort (5% real traffic) -> Phase C: Incremental expansion (25% -> 50% -> 100%) with 48h observation windows -> Phase D: Post-rollout stabilization and cost tuning. Each phase has a pre-check (health, latency, cost delta) and a rollback plan that can be tripped automatically if error rate > 1% or latency regression > 30% for 10m.
risks_and_mitigations:
- Risk: Peak demand exceeds reserved capacity for a cohort. Mitigation: Pre-allocate burst GPU pool and enable fast fallback to lower-cost model variants per smart-routing rules.
- Risk: Regression in hallucination rate after model swap. Mitigation: Attach targeted eval sets and automated quality monitors to rollout; abort if quality score drops > 5% relative to baseline.
- Risk: Console lacks observability for cohort attribution. Mitigation: DES sprint for cohort UI and ENG shipping tagging metadata in requests.
- Risk: Security/compliance approvals delay rollout. Mitigation: Early engagement with Security, request expedited review and include minimal-scope audit artifacts in PRD.
notes: This plan emphasizes synchronized commitments across teams rather than independent endpoint pushes. The goal is to reduce thrash between model updates and capacity changes by creating a single quarterly cadence for the top customer cohorts. Expect several follow-ups: (1) refine cohort prioritization based on usage telemetry, (2) finalize automated canary orchestration playbook with runbook snippets, (3) schedule a downstream CS communication for migration windows.
